checks.name: All 28 ordinary forms retain the seven actual stat names and four exact changes
Ordinary changes reject unknown stats, HP, wrong direction modifiers and missing punctuation
Source-mandated line boundaries stop names swallowing a different battle clause
Full-input anchors reject appended independent text and incomplete prefixes
Nicknames need not be species names, and actor display never infers species or identity
Same observed stat meaning preserves attacking and defending source records
All 354 move forms agree with the independently executed Japanese selector evidence
Move grammar rejects legal move names paired with another move category’s suffix
A legitimate extra source such as Wish keeps observed meaning unresolved rather than forcing the move template
An item-use slot cannot accept an arbitrary known move name
Native experience composition binds the recipient and current amount in both wording forms
Experience numbers preserve observed width and reject fabricated, padded or incomplete values
Experience source and displayed-value judgments cover all nine archived cases
Experience lookup cannot reuse an earlier recipient or amount
Eight send-out windows retain the separately reviewed current actors and source sets
Single and double source identities remain while the current send-out meaning agrees
Send-out intent cannot expose the later clear-window question or imply completion
Only reviewed windows are replaced; a full double clause remains an unreviewed source form
Window actors preserve complete display labels and reject swallowed clauses or unknown glyphs
Nine observation cases preserve every separately reviewed current source and value
Typed observations reject prose in copied names and malformed amounts
Item use keeps compatible first pages and cannot infer a later repel or flute effect
Capabilities and actual source context constrain related stat messages
Related ability names are finite and remain consistent with their call-site family
Copy/reset messages preserve two, repeated or zero actors without inventing game state
Meaning conflicts and unknown candidate meanings never choose the first result
Japanese width projection and proven glyph alternatives preserve the original actor value
The 32 original battle gaps have separately bound source and observed-meaning judgments
Only Japanese evidence, source records and rules enter template generation
Offline rebuilding is byte-for-byte identical and generated templates never contain ROM bytes

scope: bounded battle matching, separately authored fixed-case judgments, negative cases and deterministic generation; not Chinese/live acceptance
